title: Equity Brief — 26 Aug 2026
intro: Markets trade mixed during European-US crossover with VIX at 15.49 signaling normal volatility in a transitional regime characterized by modest profit-taking in mega-cap tech offset by rotation into broader indices. Session dominated by divergence between resilient European industrials and weakness in US semiconductor names dragging Nasdaq lower while Dow outperforms on weekly basis.

sections.heading: 🌍 INDEX RANKING
sections.content:
IBEX 35 20,067 +1.29% — Spanish equities lead Europe on banking strength and consumer recovery
Dow Jones 53,454 +1.32% — Best US performer this week benefiting from cyclical rotation away from tech
FTSE 100 10,878 +1.21% — UK index supported by energy and financial sectors in stable trading
DAX 26,286 +1.17% — German exporters rally on weaker euro and manufacturing optimism
FTSE MIB 52,883 +0.41% — Italian banks and utilities provide steady gains amid political stability
Nikkei 225 65,856 -0.54% — Japan underperforms on profit-taking after recent rally above 65,000
🇺🇸 US MARKET
S&P 500 at 765.41 shows consolidation near recent highs with negative intraday momentum but positive weekly trend suggesting healthy pause before potential breakout above 770 resistance driven by upcoming PCE inflation data.
Nasdaq 26,078 underperforms on semiconductor weakness with Nvidia down 2.72% weekly creating near-term pressure but 26,000 support holding firm ahead of AI infrastructure spending reports.
Dow 53,454 leads with industrials and financials outperforming tech as rotation trade extends, targeting 54,000 if manufacturing PMI surprises positive.
🇪🇺 EUROPE
DAX 26,286 +0.08% today holds above 26,000 psychological support with auto sector strength offsetting energy drag.
FTSE 100 10,878 -0.07% consolidates below 11,000 as oil volatility weighs on BP and Shell.
CAC 40 8,462 +0.27% benefits from LVMH luxury demand resilience and Airbus delivery acceleration.
💻 TECH FOCUS
Meta 577.53 +1.31% today and +5.81% weekly leads on advertising revenue upgrade from KeyBanc and AI monetization progress.
Nvidia 210.95 -0.99% today and -2.72% weekly faces profit-taking after extended run but 205 support critical for trend continuation.

sections.heading: 🎯 TRADE IDEAS
sections.content:
LONG: Meta 577.50 entry on AI advertising momentum and metaverse cost discipline — SL 565 — TP 595
LONG: DAX 26,280 on European industrial recovery and weaker euro tailwinds — SL 26,050 — TP 26,650
SHORT/AVOID: Tesla 344.26 facing delivery concern headwinds
